What I work with

Most of my current work is in Unity and C#. I’ve worked with VR, gameplay systems, interactive controllers, and university programming projects. Game programming is the direction I want to pursue professionally.

I’m particularly interested in the parts a player can feel: movement, behaviour, interaction, and the systems holding those together.

What goes here

This is the place for work in progress, smaller experiments, and notes that might be useful later. It can stay a little unfinished.
